provenance.title: Hanging heights for art
provenance.covers: How high a picture hangs, its assumed size, and the free wall it needs. Rules of thumb in our own words. No open source for the numbers was found.

sources.name: Approved Document M (UK government), for reach heights only. Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. The middle of a picture hangs about at eye level, measured from the floor.
Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. The size a picture is taken to have until the user gives one.
Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. Free wall kept beside doors, windows and corners. Walls within the close distance count as equally good. Touch: how near a wall counts as against it.
